MODEL_PATH = "output/detector_tfidf/lr_model.joblib"
CAL_PATH = "output/detector_tfidf/calibration_results.json"

    docs = []

        for i, line in enumerate(f):
            if max_lines and i >= max_lines:
                break
            docs.append(json.loads(line))
    return docs
